newsitem.title: USA: KCS sees pre-tax $9.5 mln gain in Q1.
newsitem.headline: KCS sees pre-tax $9.5 mln gain in Q1.

text.p: KCS Energy Inc said on Wednesday it expects to record a $9.5 million pre-tax gain for the quarter ending March 31 from completing the sale of its Texas natural gas pipeline system.
KCS sold the pipeline and related assets for $28.4 million in cash to a partnership formed by MCNIC Pipeline & Processing Co, an affiliate of MCN Corp, and Copano Field Services LLC.
KCS said it would use the net proceeds initially to reduce bank debt, and eventually to help fund its 1997 capital program.
